what: Count digits: each digit place has a 0~9 strip that rolls and stops on that digit — 1.2s bounce curve (overshoots to 1.03 then settles), each place .05s later. The panel appears in .4s. With on: view, it rolls out as it rises 100px above the screen bottom, and on scrolling back it rewinds to 0 and hides in .3s
ease: Bounce curve (original counterBounce — samples as is if CustomEase exists, otherwise back.out(1.4))

options.value: Number to show, base element text
options.on: load (immediately) · view (when entering the screen), default load
options.dur·stagger·delay: Rolling length · delay between positions · start delay (sec), default 1.2·.05·0
options.fx:roll: Sent to an element, it rewinds to 0 and rolls again
options.ease: Rolling curve — "0.16,1,0.3,1" or a GSAP name (expo.out), default original bounce
options.look: If plain, the top and bottom are not softly masked (outside the box is simply clipped)

from.where: shared.js nav Works count · index.html past work header count (.2s later)
